section.title: Remote control
section.subtitle: Open the session to phone browsers on the same LAN
field.enabled.label: Turn on remote control
field.enabled.help: With this on it listens on the port for phones; turning it off drops every connection at once
field.port.label: Listen port
field.port.help: Changing the port restarts the listener; paired devices are unaffected
field.lan.label: Allow LAN access
field.lan.help: With this on, phones on the same Wi-Fi can connect; with it off only this machine can
field.status.label: Status
field.address.label: Address
field.push.label: Browser push (Web Push)
field.push.help: Add this page to the phone's home screen first to get system notifications; with this off it neither subscribes nor pushes
field.pushStatus.label: Push status
field.webhook.label: Notification webhook
field.webhook.help: Empty = off. An address with {title}/{body}/{url} placeholders is sent by GET (Bark); one without them is sent as POST JSON (ntfy)
field.webhookStatus.label: Webhook status
field.testPush.label: Send a test notification
field.testPush.help: Sends one browser push and one webhook, and shows the results as corner notifications
field.devices.label: Paired devices
field.device.revoke.label: Revoke
field.device.revoke.help: Disconnect “{name}” and revoke its credentials; it has to pair again to reconnect
field.connect.label: Connect a phone
field.connect.help: Opens the connect dialog; scan the code or type it on the phone to pair. The code is valid for half an hour
field.revokeAll.label: Revoke all devices
field.revokeAll.help: Every phone stops working at once and has to pair again
field.releaseOwner.label: Give up ownership
field.releaseOwner.help: When several copies run, hand the listener to another Pneuma process; toggle remote control off and on to take it back
status.taken: Taken over by another Pneuma process (pid {pid})
status.yielded: Ownership handed over; toggle “Turn on remote control” off and on to get it back
status.waiting: Waiting for ownership to free up (retrying every 30 seconds)
pushStatus.noKey: On, but the VAPID key is unavailable
notify.waitPlan: Pneuma is waiting for plan review
notify.question: Pneuma has a question for you
notify.stillWaiting.title: Pneuma is still waiting
notify.turnEnd.title: Pneuma finished a turn
action.codeFailed: Could not issue a pairing code; try again in a moment
action.codeIssued: Pairing code generated (valid for half an hour)
action.revokedAll: Revoked {count} devices; the phones need to pair again
action.deviceGone: That device is gone (perhaps it was just revoked somewhere else)
action.testPush.title: Pneuma test notification
action.testPush.body: This message came from the test button in Settings → Remote control on the computer
action.testPush.pushNoSubs: Browser push: no subscribed devices yet (add the page to the phone's home screen first)
action.testPush.pushOff: Browser push: off (the switch is off, nothing was sent)
action.released: Ownership handed over; toggle “Turn on remote control” off and on to take it back
